description: The whole lab as a diagram: the internet, the router, both Proxmox nodes with live traffic, every VM and the services on it, green when it answers and red when it does not. Managed by anvil: change dashboards/labmap.jsonnet.

text.fixed: numbers under pve: its traffic in and out

options.content: Every box is checked live: **green** answers, **red** does not, **grey** has no data. Hosts are checked by node_exporter, services by the gateway's checks (the **SLA** dashboard has the detail), the NetBird server by its own metrics. The lines carry the colour of what they lead to, so a red line shows where the break is. The numbers by each node are its network traffic in and out. Scroll to zoom, drag to move.

title: Lab map
